ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  360 ONE WAM Limited reported mixed Q2 FY27 results, demonstrating strong underlying business growth with Assets Under Management (AUM) reaching Rs 8,99,481 crore and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) increasing by 27.5% year-on-year. However, Profit After Tax (PAT) declined by 4.4% year-on-year to Rs 302 crore, largely attributable to lower net gains on fair value changes and increased finance costs. A material red flag is the auditor's emphasis on an ongoing income tax demand and assessment stemming from a search operation, introducing financial uncertainty for the company.
